changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-whobot-skill.

- Provides a comprehensive Q&A knowledge base about WhoBot (呼波特) and related topics.
- Answers questions about company info, product features, core technologies (humanization engine & role-play flywheel), industry use cases, team, compliance, and more.
- Enforces terminology guidelines and prioritizes WhoBot's key differentiators in all responses.
- References official knowledge sources for all data and facts.
- Triggered by queries relating to WhoBot, AI phone digital employees, or related subjects, in both Chinese and English.
